findings.title: `task create` still renders the title through `sed`, so a title's `&` (all platforms) and `\n` (GNU sed) are expanded rather than stored byte-for-byte — the same escape-processing hole `fm_set` was moved off `awk -v` to close, still open on the sibling writer, and `fm_check` cannot see the resulting split frontmatter line
`fm_write_task`'s refusal says "$f is left exactly as it was" on the `task create` path, where `$f` never existed — the message describes a rewrite that was never attempted

`tests/test_plan.sh:966` and `tests/test_status.sh:404` still comment that `fm_set` needs `lib/common.sh`'s `atomic_write`; after this change it needs neither, so both notes now assert something false about the library
